title: Exploring the Jungle of Bias: Political Bias Attribution in Language Models via Dependency Analysis
findings: This paper presents no findings related to religion. Its analysis is focused on political bias in US presidential debates. It only cites a separate study that found persistent anti-Muslim bias in LLMs.
references: Abubakar Abid, Maheen Farooqi, and James Zou. 2021. Persistent anti-muslim bias in large language models. In Proceedings of the 2021 AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society. ACM.
